messages.author: 4ddc99c6029ba75d
messages.subject: scale_x_date and expand
parts:
Hi:
I was trying to use the new expand argument with scale_x_date and got
the following message

Error in get("new", env = ScaleDate, inherits = TRUE)
(ScaleDate, ...) :
unused argument(s) (expand = c(0, 0))
# This is the code for the graphic
ggplot(mwinter,aes(week1,value/1000)) +
geom_line(aes(colour=variable),size=1) +
facet_grid(variable ~ .,space="free") + labs(y="Number of fish X
1,000",x="")+ opts(legend.position="none") +
scale_x_date(major="months", minor="week",
format="%b",expand=c(0,0)) +
opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(size =
10,colour="grey50"),panel.grid.minor=theme_blank(),title="Juvenile
Winter Chinook Salmon Estimated Passage")

See attached graphic 'winter 2004_2007.jpeg'
I am trying to delete the space between 0 and July and the space at
the end between last day of June and July.
thanks

messages.author: 5ec5102a43e29af7
messages.subject: Re: scale_x_date and expand
parts:
hi,

I don't get an error message using your example with the following data:

mwinter=data.frame(week1=seq.Date(as.Date("1900-01-01"),
as.Date("1990-12-01"),by="month"))
mwinter$value=rnorm(length(mwinter$week1))
mwinter$variable=1:3

# your example
ggplot(mwinter,aes(week1,value/1000)) +

facet_grid(variable ~ .,space="free") +
geom_line(aes(colour=variable),size=1) +
facet_grid(variable ~ .,space="free") +

scale_x_date(major="months", minor="week",
format="%b",expand=c(0,0))

So the error seems to depend on your data.
Can you share a piece of your data using dput(youdata)?


regards,
Stefan
